propositions: The complexity-baseline lock script runs four times per Verified change (once per test matrix cell: Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.12), totaling ~206 runner-seconds of duplicate work
The lock is OS/Python-invariant and commit-level, so it should execute exactly once per Verified change, not once per matrix cell
Moving the unchanged lock invocation from jobs.test to jobs.lint preserves blocking policy enforcement while eliminating duplicate executions and their fetch/merge-base overhead
Workflow policy tests must enforce exactly one lock invocation in lint and zero in the test matrix to prevent regression
After moving the lock to lint, measured aggregate savings is 206 runner-seconds per Verify with policy coverage and fail-closed behavior unchanged
